tool_schemas.name: list-boards
tool_schemas.description: Lists boards visible in the specified scope, optionally filtered by organization/team/project, creator, and lifecycle status, and returns a page of boards sorted by the requested field and order. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results exist, the response includes a next cursor to request the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filter values or cursor/limit, FORBIDDEN if you lack access to the referenced organization/team/project, NOT_FOUND if a referenced scope principal ID does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: Filter boards by organization principal ID.

team_id.description: Filter boards by team principal ID.

project_id.description: Filter boards by project principal ID.

created_by_user_id.description: Filter boards by the creating user principal ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of boards to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: create-board
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new board with the given name and optional description, sharing_policy, and enterprise classification, and returns the created board. If organization_id/team_id/project_id are provided, the board is created under that container and inherits any applicable governance constraints. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for missing/invalid name or malformed policy/classification payloads, FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to create boards in the target container or to set the provided governance fields, NOT_FOUND if the target organization/team/project does not exist, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: Organization principal ID that will own the board.

team_id.description: Team principal ID under which to create the board.

project_id.description: Project principal ID under which to create the board.

sharing_policy.description: Sharing policy configuration for the board.

classification.description: Enterprise classification metadata for the board.

tool_schemas.name: update-board
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields on an existing board (name, description, sharing_policy, classification, and lifecycle status) and returns the updated board. Status changes are validated as lifecycle transitions and applied only when allowed by current board state and plan/governance rules. Raises NOT_FOUND if board_id does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to modify the board or restricted fields, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid values or refused state transitions (for example, setting an unsupported status), CONFLICT when the update cannot be applied due to the board’s current lifecycle state, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID to update.

tool_schemas.name: delete-board
tool_schemas.description: Moves the specified board to Trash (or marks it deleted according to plan/governance rules) and returns the updated board state. This operation does not permanently purge content immediately; retention and restore behavior follows the organization’s plan and governance settings. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you are not allowed to delete the board, CONFLICT if the board is already deleted or cannot be transitioned to a deleted state from its current status, VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid board_id, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID to delete (trash).

tool_schemas.name: copy-board
tool_schemas.description: Creates a new board by copying the source board’s content and settings, optionally overriding name/description, destination team/project, sharing_policy, and classification, and returns the newly created board. If a destination team_id/project_id is provided, the copy is created under that container and must comply with its governance and sharing constraints. Raises NOT_FOUND if the source board or destination container does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you cannot read the source board or create boards in the destination or set the requested overrides, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed override payloads, CONFLICT if the source board is in a lifecycle state that cannot be copied, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID of the source board to copy.

name.description: Optional name for the copied board.

description.description: Optional description for the copied board.

team_id.description: Optional destination team principal ID for the copied board.

project_id.description: Optional destination project principal ID for the copied board.

sharing_policy.description: Optional sharing policy override for the copied board.

classification.description: Optional classification override for the copied board.

tool_schemas.name: get-specific-board
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single board by board_id and returns its current metadata, including lifecycle status and any applicable sharing/governance fields. The response reflects the board’s current state at read time. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the board, VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid board_id, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get-items-on-board
tool_schemas.description: Lists board objects (items, connectors, groups, and tags) on the specified board, optionally filtered by object_type, status, parent_object_id, group_id, and creator, and returns a page of objects sorted by the requested field and order. Results are paged with limit and an opaque cursor; when more results exist, the response includes a next cursor to request the next page. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the board, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters (including unknown object_type/status), malformed IDs, or cursor/limit, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID whose items to list.

object_type.description: Filter returned objects by object type.

parent_object_id.description: Filter by parent object ID (e.g., items inside a frame/document).

group_id.description: Filter by group object ID.

created_by_user_id.description: Filter by creating user principal ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-specific-item
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single board object by object_id within the given board and returns the object with its type-specific fields, geometry, style, and current status. The object must belong to the specified board. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or the object_id is not present on that board, FORBIDDEN if you do not have access to the board/object, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal board ID containing the item.

object_id.description: Internal board object (item) ID to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: update-item-position
tool_schemas.description: Updates an existing board item’s geometry and/or its containment (parent_object_id) and grouping (group_id) and returns the updated item. Reparenting is applied only when the referenced parent exists on the same board and supports containing the item, and grouping is applied only when the referenced group exists on the same board. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board, item, parent, or group does not exist on the board, FORBIDDEN if you lack edit permission on the board/item, VALIDATION_ERROR for malformed geometry or invalid ID formats, CONFLICT if the move is not allowed due to the item’s current status (for example, deleted) or an invalid containment/grouping transition, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal id of the board containing the item.

item_id.description: Internal id of the board object (item) to reposition or reparent.

geometry.description: New geometry for the item (position/size/rotation payload stored as-is).

parent_object_id.description: New parent object id to reparent the item (e.g., frame); omit to keep unchanged.

group_id.description: Group object id to move the item into/out of a group; omit to keep unchanged.

tool_schemas.name: delete-item
tool_schemas.description: Marks the specified item as deleted on the board and returns the updated item state. Deleted items are no longer returned in active listings unless status=deleted is requested. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board or item does not exist on the board, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to delete items on the board, CONFLICT if the item is already deleted or cannot be deleted from its current state, VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: Internal id of the board containing the item.

item_id.description: Internal id of the board object (item) to delete.

tool_schemas.name: create-app-card-item

data.description: App card specific data payload stored as-is (e.g., fields/links/metadata).

group_id.description: Optional group object id to create the item inside.

def create_card_item(board_id, title=None, text_content=None, data=None, style=None, geometry=None, parent_object_id=None, group_id=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid, math
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0090000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0090000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "create-card-item"

    def _now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, code=None, message=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        row = {
            "id": "mir_req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper(),
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "timestamp": _now(),
            "status": status,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        }
        if code:
            row["error_code"] = code
        if message:
            row["error_message"] = message
        logs.append(row)
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(board_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mir_brd_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", board_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "board_id is malformed", field="board_id")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e

    for val, field in [(parent_object_id, "parent_object_id"), (group_id, "group_id")]:
        if val is not None:
            if not isinstance(val, str) or not re.match(r"^mir_obj_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", val):
                e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{field} is malformed", field=field)
                _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
                return e

    if title is not None and not isinstance(title, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title must be a string", field="title")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e
    if text_content is not None and not isinstance(text_content, str):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "text_content must be a string", field="text_content")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e
    for val, field in [(data, "data"), (style, "style"), (geometry, "geometry")]:
        if val is not None and not isinstance(val, dict):
            e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"{field} must be an object", field=field)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

    if geometry is not None:
        for k in ("x", "y"):
            if k in geometry and geometry[k] is not None:
                v = geometry[k]
                if not isinstance(v, (int, float)) or isinstance(v, bool) or (isinstance(v, float) and (math.isinf(v) or math.isnan(v))):
                    e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", f"geometry.{k} must be a finite number", field=f"geometry.{k}")
                    _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
                    return e

    boards = _load("boards.json")
    objs = _load("board_objects.json")
    links = _load("object_links.json")

    board = next((b for b in boards if b.get("id") == board_id), None)
    if not board or board.get("status") == "deleted":
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Board not found", board_id=board_id)
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e

    def _find_obj(oid):
        return next((o for o in objs if o.get("id") == oid), None)

    if parent_object_id is not None:
        p = _find_obj(parent_object_id)
        if not p or p.get("board_id") != board_id or p.get("status") != "active":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "parent_object_id not found on board", parent_object_id=parent_object_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if p.get("object_type") not in ("item_frame", "item_document", "group"):
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "parent_object_id refers to an object that cannot contain items", parent_object_id=parent_object_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

    if group_id is not None:
        g = _find_obj(group_id)
        if not g or g.get("board_id") != board_id or g.get("status") != "active":
            e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "group_id not found on board", group_id=group_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        if g.get("object_type") != "group":
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "group_id must refer to a group object", group_id=group_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e

    now = _now()
    new_id = "mir_obj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()

    item = {
        "id": new_id,
        "external_miro_object_id": None,
        "board_id": board_id,
        "object_type": "item_card",
        "status": "active",
        "parent_object_id": parent_object_id,
        "group_id": group_id,
        "title": title,
        "text_content": text_content,
        "data": data,
        "style": style,
        "geometry": geometry,
        "connector_from_object_id": None,
        "connector_to_object_id": None,
        "image_source_url": None,
        "image_asset_ref": None,
        "created_by_user_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    objs.append(item)

    # If created inside group, create group_membership link (unique)
    if group_id is not None:
        dup = next((l for l in links if l.get("board_id") == board_id and l.get("link_type") == "group_membership"
                    and l.get("from_object_id") == group_id and l.get("to_object_id") == new_id), None)
        if dup is not None:
            # Extremely unlikely, but respect uniqueness
            e = _err("CONFLICT", "Group membership already exists", group_id=group_id, item_id=new_id)
            _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
            return e
        links.append({
            "id": "mir_lnk_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper(),
            "board_id": board_id,
            "link_type": "group_membership",
            "from_object_id": group_id,
            "to_object_id": new_id,
            "position_index": None,
            "created_at": now,
            "updated_at": now,
        })

    _save("board_objects.json", objs)
    _save("object_links.json", links)

    out = {"board_id": board_id, "item": item}
    _log("ok")
    return out

tool_schemas.name: get-card-item

style.description: Visual style object for the card item.

geometry.description: Geometry object defining position/size/rotation for the card item.

group_id.description: Group object ID to assign this card item to.

parent_object_id.description: Parent object ID for hierarchical items (if applicable).

board_id.description: ID of the board containing the card item.

card_item_id.description: ID of the card item (board object) to delete.

geometry.description: Geometry object defining connector layout/waypoints (if supported).

group_id.description: Group object ID to assign this connector to.

def delete_image_item(board_id, image_item_id, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, secrets
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0090000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0090000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    endpoint = "delete-image-item"

    def _iso_now():
        return datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log_request(reqlog, credential_id, status, err_code=None):
        latency_ms = int((time.time() - t0) * 1000)
        reqlog.append({
            "id": f"mir_req_{secrets.token_hex(12).upper()}",
            "endpoint": endpoint,
            "credential_id": credential_id,
            "status": status,
            "error_code": err_code,
            "latency_ms": latency_ms,
            "timestamp": _iso_now()
        })

    reqlog = _load("request_logs.json")
    if not isinstance(reqlog, list):
        reqlog = []

    try:
        if not isinstance(board_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mir_brd_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", board_id):
            err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "board_id is malformed.")
            _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
            return err
        if not isinstance(image_item_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mir_obj_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", image_item_id):
            err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "image_item_id is malformed.")
            _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
            return err

        boards = _load("boards.json")
        if not isinstance(boards, list): boards = []
        board = next((b for b in boards if isinstance(b, dict) and b.get("id") == board_id), None)
        if not board or board.get("status") == "deleted":
            err = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Board not found.")
            _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
            return err

        objects = _load("board_objects.json")
        if not isinstance(objects, list): objects = []
        obj = next((o for o in objects if isinstance(o, dict) and o.get("id") == image_item_id and o.get("board_id") == board_id), None)
        if not obj or obj.get("status") == "deleted":
            err = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Image item not found on this board.")
            _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
            return err
        if obj.get("object_type") != "item_image":
            err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Specified object is not an image item.")
            _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
            return err

        # Soft delete
        obj["status"] = "deleted"
        now = _iso_now()
        obj["updated_at"] = now

        # Remove object_links referencing deleted objects (business rule)
        links = _load("object_links.json")
        if not isinstance(links, list): links = []
        new_links = [l for l in links if not (isinstance(l, dict) and l.get("board_id") == board_id and (l.get("from_object_id") == image_item_id or l.get("to_object_id") == image_item_id))]
        if len(new_links) != len(links):
            _save("object_links.json", new_links)

        _save("board_objects.json", objects)

        resp = {
            "deleted": True,
            "id": image_item_id,
            "board_id": board_id,
            "deleted_at": now
        }
        _log_request(reqlog, None, "success", None); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
        return resp
    except Exception as e:
        err = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Unexpected error.", detail=str(e))
        _log_request(reqlog, None, "error", err["error"]["code"]); _save("request_logs.json", reqlog)
        return err

def create_tag(board_id, title, style=None, data=None, **_extra):
    import json, os, datetime, re, time, uuid
    _DB = __import__("os").environ.get("MCP_DB_DIR") or ("./environment_mix/0090000" if __import__("os").path.isdir("./environment_mix/0090000") else "/app/database")
    def _load(n):
        try:
            with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), encoding="utf-8") as f: return json.load(f)
        except Exception: return []
    def _save(n, d):
        with open(os.path.join(_DB, n), "w", encoding="utf-8") as f: json.dump(d, f, ensure_ascii=False, indent=2)
    def _err(code, msg, **x): return {"error": {"code": code, "message": msg, **x}}

    t0 = time.time()
    now = datetime.datetime.utcnow().replace(microsecond=0).isoformat() + "Z"

    def _log(status, code=None, message=None, meta=None):
        logs = _load("request_logs.json")
        if not isinstance(logs, list):
            logs = []
        logs.append({
            "id": "req_" + uuid.uuid4().hex,
            "endpoint": "create-tag",
            "status": status,
            "error_code": code,
            "error_message": message,
            "meta": meta or {},
            "credential_id": None,
            "timestamp": now,
            "latency_ms": int((time.time() - t0) * 1000),
        })
        _save("request_logs.json", logs)

    if not isinstance(board_id, str) or not re.match(r"^mir_brd_[0-9A-Z]{18,}$", board_id):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "Malformed board_id.", field="board_id")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"field": "board_id"})
        return e
    if not isinstance(title, str) or not title.strip():
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "title is required and must be a non-empty string.", field="title")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"field": "title"})
        return e
    if style is not None and not isinstance(style, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "style must be an object.", field="style")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"field": "style"})
        return e
    if data is not None and not isinstance(data, dict):
        e = _err("VALIDATION_ERROR", "data must be an object.", field="data")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"field": "data"})
        return e

    boards = _load("boards.json")
    objs = _load("board_objects.json")
    if not isinstance(boards, list) or not isinstance(objs, list):
        e = _err("CONFLICT", "Datastore is not in expected format.")
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"])
        return e

    board = next((b for b in boards if b.get("id") == board_id), None)
    if not board:
        e = _err("NOT_FOUND", "Board not found.", board_id=board_id)
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"board_id": board_id})
        return e

    # quota: max active tags per board (local rule)
    active_tags = [o for o in objs if o.get("board_id") == board_id and o.get("object_type") == "tag" and o.get("status") == "active"]
    TAG_LIMIT = 200
    if len(active_tags) >= TAG_LIMIT:
        e = _err("QUOTA_EXCEEDED", "Tag limit reached for this board.", limit=TAG_LIMIT, current=len(active_tags))
        _log("error", e["error"]["code"], e["error"]["message"], {"board_id": board_id, "limit": TAG_LIMIT})
        return e

    # generate id
    def _new_obj_id():
        return "mir_obj_" + uuid.uuid4().hex.upper()[:20]
    new_id = _new_obj_id()
    existing_ids = {o.get("id") for o in objs if isinstance(o, dict)}
    while new_id in existing_ids:
        new_id = _new_obj_id()

    row = {
        "id": new_id,
        "external_miro_object_id": None,
        "board_id": board_id,
        "object_type": "tag",
        "status": "active",
        "parent_object_id": None,
        "group_id": None,
        "title": title,
        "text_content": None,
        "data": data if data is not None else None,
        "style": style if style is not None else None,
        "geometry": None,
        "connector_from_object_id": None,
        "connector_to_object_id": None,
        "image_source_url": None,
        "image_asset_ref": None,
        "created_by_user_id": None,
        "created_at": now,
        "updated_at": now,
    }

    objs.append(row)
    _save("board_objects.json", objs)

    _log("success", meta={"board_id": board_id, "tag_id": new_id})

    return {
        "id": row["id"],
        "board_id": row["board_id"],
        "object_type": row["object_type"],
        "status": row["status"],
        "title": row["title"],
        "style": row["style"],
        "data": row["data"],
        "created_at": row["created_at"],
        "updated_at": row["updated_at"],
    }

tool_schemas.name: get-mindmap-node
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves a single mind map node by `node_id` from the specified board and returns the node object. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, and NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or the node is not present on that board. Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view the board or its content, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: ID of the board that contains the mind map node.

node_id.description: ID of the mind map node object to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get-mindmap-nodes
tool_schemas.description: Lists mind map nodes on the specified board, optionally filtered by `parent_object_id` and `status`, and returns a paged collection sorted by `sort`; use `limit` and the opaque `cursor` to retrieve additional pages. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid `status`/`sort`, or `limit` out of range, and NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist (or if `parent_object_id` is provided but does not exist on the board). Raises FORBIDDEN if you don’t have permission to view the board or its content, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: ID of the board to list mind map nodes from.

parent_object_id.description: If provided, only return mind map nodes under this parent object.

limit.description: Maximum number of nodes to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: delete-mindmap-node
tool_schemas.description: Deletes the specified mind map node from the board and returns an acknowledgement of deletion. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, and NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or the node is not present on that board. Raises CONFLICT if the node cannot be deleted due to its current state or dependency rules, FORBIDDEN if you lack permission to edit board content, and RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: ID of the board that contains the mind map node.

node_id.description: ID of the mind map node object to delete.

tool_schemas.name: get-board-classification
tool_schemas.description: Returns the current Enterprise governance classification assigned to the specified board. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid `board_id`, NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist, and FORBIDDEN if the board is not in an Enterprise organization or you lack permission to view governance settings for the board. Raises RATE_LIMITED when quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: ID of the board to retrieve classification for.

tool_schemas.name: update-board-classification
tool_schemas.description: Updates the Enterprise classification applied to the specified board and returns the board’s current classification metadata after the change. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if board_id does not match the expected ID format or the classification payload is missing/invalid, NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or is not accessible in the caller’s organization, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks Enterprise governance permissions or the organization is not on an Enterprise plan. Raises CONFLICT if the board is under a legal hold/eDiscovery restriction that prevents changing classification, and RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

board_id.description: ID of the board to update.

classification.description: Enterprise classification object to apply to the board.

tool_schemas.name: create-board-export-job
tool_schemas.description: Creates an Enterprise export job for the specified set of boards and returns the created job record (including its export_job_id and initial status). Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id/board_ids are invalid, board_ids is empty, or any board_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the organization or any referenced board does not exist or is not in the organization, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks export permissions or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises CONFLICT if an export cannot be started for one or more boards due to governance restrictions (for example, an active legal hold) and RATE_LIMITED if job-creation quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization creating the export job.

board_ids.description: One or more board IDs to export.

payload.description: Export job configuration (e.g., format/options) stored as job payload.

tool_schemas.name: get-board-export-job-status
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves the current status and progress metadata for a single Enterprise board export job and returns the job record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if export_job_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible within the caller’s organization, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view export jobs or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

export_job_id.description: ID of the board export job to check.

tool_schemas.name: get-board-export-job-results
tool_schemas.description: Lists the result entries produced by a completed (or partially completed) Enterprise export job and returns up to limit results plus a next cursor when more are available; pass cursor to fetch the next page. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if export_job_id is malformed or limit is out of range, NOT_FOUND if the job does not exist or is not visible within the caller’s organization, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view export results or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises CONFLICT if results are requested before the job has produced any results (for example, still initializing) and RATE_LIMITED when read quotas are exceeded.

export_job_id.description: ID of the board export job whose results to retrieve.

limit.description: Maximum number of results to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of results.

tool_schemas.name: get-audit-logs
tool_schemas.description: Returns a page of Enterprise audit events for the organization filtered by occurred_after/occurred_before and ordered by occurred_at according to sort_order; the response includes up to limit events and a cursor for the next page when available. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id is malformed, timestamps are invalid, occurred_after is outside the last 90 days, or occurred_before is earlier than occurred_after, NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist or is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks audit-log access or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when audit-log retrieval quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization whose audit events to retrieve.

occurred_after.description: Filter to audit events that occurred at or after this timestamp (must be within last 90 days).

occurred_before.description: Filter to audit events that occurred before this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of audit events to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of audit events.

tool_schemas.name: get-organization-info
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns Enterprise organization details for the specified organization_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist or is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view organization governance data or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: get-organization-members
tool_schemas.description: Lists members (principals) in the specified Enterprise organization, optionally filtered by status and sorted by sort_by/sort_order; returns up to limit members and a cursor for the next page when more results exist. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id is malformed or if status/sort_by/sort_order/limit are invalid, NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist or is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to list organization members or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization whose members to list.

limit.description: Maximum number of members to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page of members.

sort_order.description: Sort order for the chosen sort_by field.

tool_schemas.name: get-organization-member
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns a single organization member record for member_principal_id within the specified Enterprise organization. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if organization_id or member_principal_id is malformed, NOT_FOUND if the organization does not exist, the member is not part of the organization, or the record is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view organization members or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization that the member belongs to.

member_principal_id.description: ID of the member principal to retrieve.

tool_schemas.name: add-project-member
tool_schemas.description: Adds the specified principal as a member of the given project principal with the requested role, and returns the resulting project membership record. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/member_principal_id are malformed, role is not one of the supported values, or project_id does not identify a project principal, NOT_FOUND if the project or member principal does not exist or is not accessible, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to manage project membership or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises CONFLICT if the member already has project membership or if the role change is not allowed by the project’s current governance restrictions, and RATE_LIMITED when write quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project principal to add the member to (principal_type=project).

member_principal_id.description: ID of the principal being added as a project member (typically a user principal).

role.description: Role to grant the member within the project context.

tool_schemas.name: get-project-member
tool_schemas.description: Retrieves and returns the membership details for member_principal_id in the specified project principal. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if project_id/member_principal_id are malformed or project_id does not identify a project principal, NOT_FOUND if the project does not exist, the member is not a member of the project, or the record is not accessible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view project membership or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled. Raises RATE_LIMITED when request quotas are exceeded.

project_id.description: ID of the project principal to look up membership for (principal_type=project).

member_principal_id.description: ID of the member principal whose project membership should be retrieved.

tool_schemas.name: remove-project-member
tool_schemas.description: Removes the specified member principal from the given project principal and returns an empty success response. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if either ID is missing or does not match the expected principal ID format, NOT_FOUND if the project or member principal does not exist, and CONFLICT if the member is not currently a member of the project. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not permitted to manage project membership, or if the organization is not on an Enterprise plan / governance scope required for this operation.

project_id.description: ID of the project principal to remove the member from (principal_type=project).

member_principal_id.description: ID of the member principal to remove from the project.

tool_schemas.name: get-all-cases
tool_schemas.description: Lists eDiscovery cases for the specified organization principal and returns a paged result set sorted by the requested field and order; pass the returned cursor to fetch the next page until no cursor is returned. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid organization_id, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if the organization principal does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you do not have eDiscovery access for the organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

organization_id.description: ID of the organization principal to list eDiscovery cases for (principal_type=organization).

limit.description: Maximum number of cases to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-case
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for a single eDiscovery case enterprise record by case_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if case_id is missing or does not match the eDiscovery case ID format, and NOT_FOUND if the case record does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view eDiscovery cases in the owning organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

case_id.description: ID of the eDiscovery case enterprise_ops record (record_type=ediscovery_case).

tool_schemas.name: get-all-legal-holds
tool_schemas.description: Lists legal holds within the specified eDiscovery case and returns a paged result set; use limit and cursor to paginate and sort/order to control result ordering. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for an invalid case_id, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if the case does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view legal holds for the case’s organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

case_id.description: ID of the eDiscovery case enterprise_ops record to list legal holds for (record_type=ediscovery_case).

status.description: Filter legal holds by hold status.

limit.description: Maximum number of legal holds to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-legal-hold
tool_schemas.description: Returns details for a single legal hold enterprise record by legal_hold_id. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR if legal_hold_id is missing or does not match the legal hold ID format, and NOT_FOUND if the legal hold record does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view the legal hold in its owning organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

legal_hold_id.description: ID of the legal hold enterprise_ops record (record_type=legal_hold).

tool_schemas.name: get-legal-hold-content-items
tool_schemas.description: Lists content items currently associated with the specified legal hold, optionally filtered by board_id and/or a specific object_id, and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid enum values, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if the legal hold does not exist (or if provided board_id/object_id do not exist). Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to view legal hold contents for the owning organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

legal_hold_id.description: ID of the legal hold enterprise_ops record to list held content for (record_type=legal_hold).

board_id.description: Optional filter to return only held content items for a specific board.

object_id.description: Optional filter to return a specific held content item by object ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of held content items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-board-content-logs
tool_schemas.description: Lists immutable content change log records for items on the specified board within the given organization, optionally restricted to a single object_id and/or an occurred_at time window, and returns a paged result set using limit and cursor with the requested sort. Raises VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid IDs, invalid date-time ranges, invalid status/sort values, or out-of-range limit, and NOT_FOUND if the organization or board does not exist. Raises FORBIDDEN if you are not authorized to access board content logs for the organization or the organization is not Enterprise-enabled.

organization_id.description: Organization principal id that owns the enterprise data.

board_id.description: Board id to retrieve content change logs for.

object_id.description: Optional board object id to restrict logs to a single item.

status.description: Record status filter (board content logs are stored as immutable records).

occurred_from.description: Return only logs with occurred_at greater than or equal to this timestamp.

occurred_to.description: Return only logs with occurred_at less than or equal to this timestamp.

limit.description: Maximum number of logs to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for fetching the next page.

tool_schemas.name: get-board
tool_schemas.description: Fetches a single board by internal board_id and returns its full board record if the caller has access. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or is not visible to the caller, and FORBIDDEN if the caller lacks permission to view the board in the requested status scope.

board_id.description: Internal board ID to fetch.

include_trashed.description: When true, allows returning a board in status='trashed' if the caller has access; otherwise trashed boards are treated as not found.

include_deleted.description: When true and the caller is privileged, allows returning a board in status='deleted'; otherwise deleted boards are treated as not found.

tool_schemas.name: list-board-items
tool_schemas.description: Lists active item objects on a board (board_objects where object_type starts with 'item_' and status='active') and returns a page of results ordered by updated_at descending unless otherwise specified. Raises NOT_FOUND if the board does not exist or is not accessible, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid filters, limit, or cursor.

board_id.description: Board ID whose items to list.

parent_object_id.description: Filter by parent container object ID (e.g., a frame).

group_id.description: Filter items by group container ID.

limit.description: Maximum number of items to return.

cursor.description: Opaque pagination cursor for the next page.

tool_schemas.name: update-item
tool_schemas.description: Updates mutable fields of a single board object (item or connector) and returns the updated object. Geometry/parent changes are constrained to the same board and validated against container rules; status changes are validated as lifecycle transitions. Raises NOT_FOUND if the object is not accessible, FORBIDDEN if the caller cannot edit the board, and VALIDATION_ERROR for invalid patches.

board_id.description: Board ID containing the object.

title.description: New title for the object.

text_content.description: New text content for the object.

data.description: Updated type-specific data payload.

style.description: Updated style payload.

geometry.description: Updated geometry payload (position/size/rotation).

parent_object_id.description: Move under a new parent container object on the same board.

connector_from_object_id.description: For connectors only: update the source endpoint object ID.

connector_to_object_id.description: For connectors only: update the target endpoint object ID.

status.description: Update object lifecycle status (soft delete supported).

tool_schemas.name: get-caller-context
tool_schemas.description: Returns the authenticated caller identity, granted scopes, and current quota/rate-limit consumption as seen by the API. Refuses requests with invalid/expired credentials.

access_token.description: Bearer access token to introspect; if omitted, the token from the request context is used when supported by the client.

metadata.name: Miro Server
metadata.description: This backend stores Miro organizations/teams/projects, boards, board content items (multiple item types with shared geometry/style), board membership/sharing, grouping and tagging, plus enterprise-only governance data like classifications, audit logs, exports, eDiscovery cases/legal holds, and board
